rounding: ratios to 6 decimals, percentages to 2 decimals, means and standard deviations to 4 decimals; 'exact' is the unrounded fraction
labels: artifact names and citation paths are written with a space on each side of every slash, so that this file is not counted as a citation of the artifacts it lists

feeder_rule.kind: the pinned rule, re-implemented; rule_cases are imaginary rows from scenarios.json
feeder_rule.statement: rebaseline = the artifact has a previous row AND that row's citation_source differs from the current one (a missing key reads as null); delta_citations = 0 if rebaseline, else the count minus the previous row's count, taken as 0 when there is no previous row or it has no count; citation_count is written as read in either case

rule_cases.name: new_artifact
rule_cases.description: First row of an artifact, measured by git grep.

rule_cases.name: first_computed_value
rule_cases.description: The previous row holds a hand-typed count and no citation_source; the new count comes from git grep.

rule_cases.name: two_more_citing_files
rule_cases.description: Both rows come from git grep.

rule_cases.name: outside_the_repository
rule_cases.description: An artifact that git grep cannot measure: no citation_source before or after.

rule_cases.name: second_version_of_the_source
rule_cases.description: A hypothetical later producer stamps a different source.

rule_cases.name: source_tag_removed
rule_cases.description: The evolution record loses its citation_source and keeps its count.

rule_cases.name: citation_paths_edited
rule_cases.description: Someone adds a second path to the record's citation_paths list; the producer and its source tag are unchanged.

producer_docstring_cross_check.text: Until 2026-09 every evolution metric was typed by hand when a session wrote an entry, and nothing updated it afterwards: scripts/quality_trend.py read the same numbers for 46 nights (last change 2026-07-29) and emitted zero deltas. The hand counts were also not measurements — alignment-policy said 3 citations while 42 tracked files name it.

definitions.no_count: the row has no citation_count (a seed row)
definitions.first_count: the row has a count and no earlier row of the artifact has one: nothing to compare with
definitions.instrument_change: the previous row has a count and another citation_source (a missing key reads as null)
definitions.same_instrument: the previous row has a count and the same citation_source
definitions.count changed: the row's count differs from the previous row's count (defined only when that row has one)

total_series.definition: total = citation_count summed over the artifacts that have a count in the run

two_sigma.kind: computed with an analysis rule from scenarios.json; not a project alarm
two_sigma.rule: a step is flagged when it differs from the mean of all earlier steps of its series by more than 2 population standard deviations of those steps; a step with fewer than 3 earlier steps is not tested

total.definition: step of the citation count summed over every artifact that has a count

recorded_delta.definition: sum of delta_citations as the feeder wrote it (the step hidden by a rebaseline flag is not in it)

same_instrument.definition: sum of the count steps of rows whose previous row has a count from the same source

run_spacing.kind: computed from the run timestamps; days are rounded to 4 decimals

per_day.kind: computed; the same analysis rule, on steps per day
per_day.definition: each step divided by the time since the previous run, in days; a step per day is flagged when it differs from the mean of all earlier steps per day by more than the rule's multiple of their population standard deviation; days and steps per day are rounded to 4 decimals

transfer_task.note: Hypothetical defect log of a software team, for the learner task. Not Streeling data and not a forecast.
transfer_task.unit: open defect reports per component, logged once a week
transfer_task.q5: no single answer: see the review brief
